milestone: A56 ordinary-CV Iterator DATA destructor during array spread

runtime.scope: Ordinary CV of a named user Iterator with a real public non-generator __destruct and no owning instance children. Normal last-DATA release and supplied key throw retain the partial builder through the destructor. Invalid bool-key insert instead enters generic eager cleanup: builder, DATA, then current cache are released in that order; the builder is gone before the destructor while the cache remains owned.
